results.title: Rosario
results.overview: Rosario is a coming-of-age tale that blends romance with the slow-burn tension of a Hitchcock mystery. Set during Holy Week in a provincial Filipino town, the story follows a young woman whose innocence is tested when her father invites a priest-in-training to live in their home. Underneath the romance lies an air of suspense, where faith, desire, and secrecy collide. With nods to classic cinema, Rosario explores the fragile line between devotion and temptation.

results.title: The Reeds
results.overview: In a village in Anatolia at the foothills of the mountains, a young man resists the domination of landlords and local gangs while striving to win back his wife's love and affection.

results.title: Rocky Road
results.overview: On a brief but emotionally charged road trip, two sisters whose constant bickering threatens to derail their journey unexpectedly find their way back to the love that binds them.

results.title: Congregation
results.overview: People leave (and return) from a church after Sunday Mass more than 120 years ago. The creaking of time and the darkness behind the ancient ritual of praying for our existence dance eternally, like a river of souls. Liz Taylor's visualy noisy reinterpretation of the film "Congregation Leaving St. Mary's Pro-Cathedral, Dublin" (1901) by the Edwardian filmmaking duo James Kenyon and Sagar Mitchell.

results.original_title: Elite Force: B.R.I. - Body Recovery Immunisation
results.overview: Homeless ex-soldiers from around the world are kidnapped and shipped to a mad scientist in London, England, who has plans to repair, restore and send them on dangerous missions to take vengeance against corruption around the world.

results.title: The Hounds Gate Haunting
results.overview: When an amateur troupe stages a ghost story at Nottingham's historic Hounds Gate Theater, they awaken the theater's real-life phantom. Will they make it out alive?

results.title: Edgar Allan Poe's The Oval Portrait
results.original_title: Edgar Allan Poe's The Oval Portrait
results.overview: A wounded narrator finds refuge in an abandoned Italian chateau and discovers a lifelike portrait of a young woman.

results.title: Just a Man: Sam the Hotel
results.original_title: Just a Man: Sam the Hotel
results.overview: The rise and fall of an American film icon. Premiered at ScannerDance 2025.

results.title: The Lyric Theatre: A Christmas Carol
results.original_title: The Lyric Theatre: A Christmas Carol
results.overview: Nobody hates Christmas more than the selfish miser Ebenezer Scrooge. But on a cold Christmas Eve, he’s taken on an extraordinary journey through time that presents him with an opportunity to face his past — and change the future — before time runs out.

results.title: About Narration
results.overview: Interdisciplinary studies put into practice is a plane on which HaF's interests and mine coincide. Ideas of fictional research projects in films emerge very early on, or of film as research device, allowing people from different disciplines to come together and discover something, to pursue a line of thought, or just be adventurous. These ideas correspond to a tendency we both have of accumulating knowledge from different sciences, for example so as to bring exact sciences like medicine together with subjects which aren't directly aimed at application, such as religious studies or anthropology.

results.title: Oflu Hodja 5: Marriage
results.overview: Since the death of his wife, Oflu Hoca has been living a bachelor's life. Saddened by his situation, his friends decide to marry him off. However, in the process, they find themselves on an unexpected adventure.

results.title: Goodnight
results.overview: A hospice nurse revisits the comfort and fear of childhood when she hires a babysitter to take care of her for the night.

results.title: As Beautiful As Love
results.overview: Guided by her grandfather, young Fran finds the courage to face grief and longing, embarking on a playful yet heartfelt journey where she confronts an eccentric neighbour and discovers the power of resilience.

results.title: Isle of Snakes
results.overview: A strange drifting story of three men who once went to war on a turtle ship, but were shipwrecked and washed up on an uninhabited island.

results.title: Against All Odds
results.overview: Against All Odds is the gripping sequel to Try That Again, following Jason, Jocelyn, and the enigmatic bartender Lexian as they navigate the dangerous consequences of Jason’s repeated manipulations of time. Hunted by Xaldin, a relentless enforcer of the natural order, the trio must outwit their pursuer and confront the ripple effects of their past choices. Every decision carries weight, and survival may demand sacrifices they never imagined. Can they stay one step ahead of destiny itself—against all odds?

results.title: Velvet Vision: The Story of James Bidgood and the Making of Pink Narcissus
results.original_title: Velvet Vision: The Story of James Bidgood and the Making of Pink Narcissus
results.overview: Velvet Vision is a raw and intimate portrait of James Bidgood, the visionary artist behind the cult classic Pink Narcissus, who’s groundbreaking 1960s homoerotic imagery helped redefine queer aesthetics.

results.title: Shaba Daba
results.overview: A passionate Italian-American Chef tries to fix his Niece's quirk of only speaking in her made-up language: "Shaba Daba" - all while cooking chicken parmesan together.
